六级大纲词汇 · 05英文原文

The Crack Under the Drum

搅拌筒下面的裂缝 · 590 词 · 7 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1At a shipyard a mixing drum began to vibrate under a full load. A thermal gauge registered nothing unusual, but Eva, an apprentice at the console, heard a scrape near the shaft. Her mentor wanted her to stop the diesel motor before the vibration worsened. A fault in the hybrid drive could void its warranty. The safety pedal responded. She checked the ignition, closed the inlet valve, and put on a helmet and protective vest. The drum was meant to glide over its bearings. The foreman gave her an hour. After that the logistics of moving the batch would delay production.

2With a socket wrench Eva removed a rusty guard. An alloy collar had a bright spiral groove beside an old patch of corrosion. The shaft could rotate while moving sideways. With the drum empty, a rod showed perfect alignment. Eva used a lever to tilt the cylinder under a test load. A crack opened below it. Tightening a knob did nothing. Rather than dismantle the drum, she marked the crack and used a jack to relieve the support.

3A replacement would take a week to fabricate. That time constraint made it impractical. Eva drew a duplicate bracket on scrap steel. She could incorporate a spare collar from an obsolete propeller assembly. The prototype used a composite pad to insulate the motor, but her mentor noticed a drawback. Compression might introduce slack. A solid insulator around the wiring would suffice. They chose a stiffer alloy and used a versatile cutter to remove an overlapping edge before detaching the bracket.

4Fabrication alone could not rectify the cause. A hose ran beside the radiator into a narrow compartment. A ventilation upgrade had rerouted it across a clamp. That configuration blocked a channel meant to lubricate the collar. With lubrication cut off, friction had made the collar seize. Rust had clogged the old vent. A narrower one would leave room for the hose. Eva drew the route on the cover and checked where the bracket might corrode.

5The crew activated the system with the clutch disengaged. An array of lights came on. On a separate screen the graph showed only static. Its cable passed near a socket on the power grid. A damaged connector lost contact whenever the case shook. The electrician moved the cable and added insulation to prevent an electrical arc. He connected an auxiliary gauge to a separate fuse and checked its watt rating against the label. That second loop might appear redundant. Its redundancy mattered if a single fault could silence the first warning.

6In the next trial two sensors gave simultaneous readings. Eva began to scrutinize the graphs for a concurrent fault. She asked for one full batch before anyone could certify the repair. At noon she opened the valve. The drive could now handle a wider range of loads. In the certification note, the foreman recorded the rectification of both faults. A clear oil channel and a gauge that worked under load were complementary changes. Both helped prevent another failure.

7A week later the foreman offered Eva a commendation. She asked him to augment the inspection sheet with two pictures instead. The first showed the hose behind the radiator. The second showed the connector inside its compartment. The incorporation of both pictures would help a new apprentice spot the original blunder. A picture of the bracket's displacement would complement the notes and streamline inspections. When an apprentice asked what had broken the bracket, Eva handed him the clamp. The cause of the failure fitted in his palm.

搅拌筒下面的裂缝

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1造船厂的一只搅拌筒满载时开始振动。温度表没有显示异常，但操作台前的学徒伊娃听到轴附近传来摩擦声。师傅让她趁振动还没加剧先停掉柴油机。混合动力传动装置出了故障，可能导致保修失效。安全踏板仍然有反应。她检查点火装置，关掉进料阀，戴上头盔和防护背心。筒体本该在轴承上平稳转动。工头给她一小时，再晚就要安排转运这批料，耽误生产。

2伊娃用套筒扳手卸下生锈的护罩。合金轴环上有一道亮闪闪的螺旋槽，旁边是旧的腐蚀斑。轴可以一边转一边横移。搅拌筒空载时，用直杆一比，两端完全对齐。伊娃加上测试负载，再用杠杆把筒体稍稍倾斜，底下便张开一道裂缝。拧紧旋钮也没有用。她在裂缝旁做了记号，用千斤顶减轻支座的负担，暂时保留搅拌筒的整体结构。

3加工一个新支座需要一星期，时间来不及。伊娃在废钢上描出原支架的形状，打算装上一只旧螺旋桨总成的备用轴环。样件采用复合材料垫隔开电机和底座。师傅看出一个缺点，垫子受压后可能导致松动。在线路周围用一层硬质绝缘材料就够了。他们换用更硬的合金，用多用途切割工具切掉搭在一起的边缘，再拆下支架。

4做出新支架还解决不了故障的根源。一根软管沿着散热器伸进狭小隔间。上次改通风系统时，软管被改了走向，正好压在管夹上。这种布置堵住了给轴环送润滑油的通道。没了润滑，摩擦使轴环卡死。旧通风口被铁锈堵住了。换个更窄的通风口，就能给软管留出空间。伊娃把路线画在盖板上，又检查新支架在原位会不会被腐蚀。

5工人让离合器处于分离状态，然后启动系统。一排灯亮起来，另一块屏幕上的曲线却全是杂讯。它的线缆经过电源插座旁。外壳一抖，损坏的接头就接触不良。电工挪开线缆并加了绝缘层，防止产生电弧。他给辅助仪表接上单独的保险丝，核对铭牌上的额定功率。平时第二个回路似乎多余，可一处故障就可能使第一道警报失效。

6下一次试验中，两个传感器同时传回读数。伊娃仔细查看曲线，确认有没有同时发生的其他故障。她坚持跑完一整批料再验收。正午，她打开阀门。传动装置现在能承受更宽范围的负载。工头在验收记录里写下两处故障的整改情况。一条畅通的油路和一块在负载下仍然工作的仪表，两项改动配合起来，避免支架再次损坏。

7一周后，工头想表彰伊娃。她请他在检查表上加两张照片，一张拍散热器后面的软管，一张拍隔间里的接头。新学徒看了图，就能认出原先的安装失误。再配一张显示支架偏移的照片，检查起来更省事。有位学徒问支架为什么会坏，伊娃把小小的管夹递给他。整个故障的根源，放在手掌上就看得清楚。
